section: Translator note on dasha-result chapter and Chapter 31 usage
translation: The edition notes that Chapter 31 is dedicated to Vimshottari and describes it as widely used, while also pointing readers back to Phaladeepika, Saravali, Jataka Parijata, and other dasha treatments.
context_before: The note clarifies that previous chapters refer to a different moola-dasha framework.
context_after: The editor then summarizes how related texts handle antardasha and opening-dasha issues.
citation_label: Hora Sara editorial note at p. 192 (Santhanam tr.)
notes: This is explicitly registered as commentarial material rather than as a root Sanskrit verse.
